canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall {iota alpha : Type*} [DecidableEq alpha] (s : Finset iota) (S : iota -> Finset alpha), ((s.biUnion S).card : Int) = sum over nonempty t subset s of (-1)^(t.card+1) * (intersection over i in t of S i).card
